verdict.rationale: Mercury advertises 'no-fee USD payments around the globe' and API/dashboard support for domestic/international wire transfers, but all evidence points to USD-denominated payments — there is no mention of sending in local/foreign currencies or FX conversion, and wire fee transparency is not detailed beyond the USD no-fee claim. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-currency/local-currency disbursement, FX rate transparency, and fee schedules for international wires beyond the USD-only claim.
